title: Romantic Valentine proposal page with evasive No button and meme on Yes

requirements.text: Create a single-page romantic Valentine proposal experience in the frontend that asks: "Will you be my Valentine?" with two options: "Yes" and "No", using a consistent pink-and-white theme.

quotes: Create an interactive web page... to ask her to be my valentine... Romantically with a pink and white colour scheme

acceptanceCriteria: The landing view shows a centered romantic card/section with the question text: "Will you be my Valentine?"
The UI uses a coherent pink-and-white color scheme across background, typography, and buttons
The page is usable on Android Chrome (mobile viewport) without horizontal scrolling

requirements.text: Implement playful interaction where the "No" button evades user interaction: when the user attempts to hover over or touch the "No" button, it moves to a new random position within a bounded container so it cannot be clicked.

quotes: when she hovers her cursor over no,it should move away so she cannot click it,forcing her to click only on yes

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop: moving the cursor onto the "No" button triggers it to relocate within the visible bounds of its container
On mobile: tapping/pressing near/on the "No" button triggers it to relocate within the visible bounds of its container
The "No" button never moves off-screen or under other UI in a way that makes the page layout break
It is not possible to click/tap the "No" button under normal use because it moves away before activation

requirements.text: When the user clicks/taps "Yes", transition to an acceptance state that displays a meme image and the text: "Good choice" (exact capitalization).

quotes: when she click yes,show her a meme image telling her"good choice

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping "Yes" replaces (or clearly transitions from) the initial question view to a success view
The success view includes the text "Good choice" exactly
The success view displays the provided/generated meme image reliably as a static asset in the frontend (not fetched from the backend)

requirements.text: Ensure the page is fully interactive with client-side logic only and requires no backend canister functionality to operate.

quotes: be fully interactive using HTML,CSS,and JAVAScript so that i can easily run in on my Android phone using chrome.

acceptanceCriteria: All interactions (No evasion, Yes success state) work without calling backend methods
The backend canister does not need new APIs for this feature
The frontend runs as a static interactive page within the app (React app in the browser)

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components); compose them instead if needed.
Do not edit immutable hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: User accounts or authentication flows (Internet Identity)
Storing proposal responses or analytics on-chain
Real-time features, messaging, email, or notifications
Multiple pages/routes beyond the single interactive proposal screen

required: Romantic meme-style image with the caption "Good choice" integrated in the image (valentine-meme-good-choice.dim_1024x1024.png)
